Quantities estimated for the ingredients the source gives as «q.b.» (as needed: celery leaves, stock).
Con la pancetta al posto del prosciutto;: With pancetta instead of prosciutto; with mushrooms in the sauce.
Togliere la pelle alla luganega e sbrici: Skin the luganega and crumble it.
Rosolarla in una padella larga senza gra: Brown it in a wide pan without fat for 8 minutes, until golden.
Sciogliere lo zafferano in un cucchiaio: Dissolve the saffron in a spoonful of hot water and add it to the fresh liquid cream.
Versare la panna sulla salsiccia e cuoce: Pour the cream over the sausage and cook for 4 minutes over low heat; add salt and pepper.
Cuocere le penne rigate in acqua salata: Cook the penne rigate in salted water for the stated time, usually 11 minutes, and drain them al dente.
Saltarle nel sugo con il parmigiano grat: Toss them in the sauce with the grated parmesan and serve them with chopped parsley.
La luganega di Monza è la salsiccia sott: Monza luganega is the long thin sausage of Brianza, which also goes into Monza-style risotto; with cream and saffron it is a quick first course that GialloZafferano gives this way. Ingredients and quantities are those of the GialloZafferano page; the method is rewritten here, in more detail.
Con il riso al posto della pasta; senza: With rice instead of pasta; without cream, with a ladle of stock.
Lavare gli spinaci e saltarli in padella: Wash the spinach and sauté it in a pan with a drizzle of oil for 4 minutes; salt it and keep a few raw leaves aside to garnish.
Togliere la crosta allo scimudin e tagli: Remove the rind from the scimudin and cut it into small pieces.
Scioglierlo a fuoco basso con la panna f: Melt it over low heat with the fresh liquid cream and the butter, stirring, into a smooth fondue; add the grated parmesan.
Cuocere gli spaghetti in acqua salata e: Cook the spaghetti in salted water and drain them al dente.
Saltarli con gli spinaci e la fonduta pe: Toss them with the spinach and the fondue for 1 minute.
Servirli con un pizzico di pesteda valte: Serve them with a pinch of Valtellina pesteda and a few spinach leaves.
Lo scimudin è un formaggio fresco di lat: Scimudin is a fresh cow's milk cheese from the Valtellina; pesteda is salt pounded with herbs from Grosio. It is a modern first course that GialloZafferano gives this way. Ingredients and quantities are those of the GialloZafferano page; the method is rewritten here, in more detail. Quantities estimated for the ingredients the source gives as «q.b.» (as needed: extra virgin olive oil, Valtellina pesteda (herb salt)).
Con la toma al posto dello scimudin; con: With toma instead of scimudin; with pizzoccheri.
